product_family: Creately is an AI-powered visual collaboration and diagramming platform. Main products: Creately SaaS (cloud) and Creately Enterprise On-Premise for self-hosted deployments. Supports flowcharts, org charts, mind maps, UML, ERDs, network diagrams, and AI-assisted diagram generation.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: We have successfully completed a SOC 2 Type 2 audit. The audit confirms that security controls protect customer data and validates adherence to Trust Services Criteria for Security, Availability, and Confidentiality.

certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Creately is ISO 27001 certified. This demonstrates they maintain a comprehensive Information Security Management System meeting global standards for risk management and operational excellence.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: We support healthcare and life sciences organizations by maintaining HIPAA compliance. They provide necessary safeguards for electronic Protected Health Information and will sign Business Associate Agreements with enterprise partners.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: We are fully committed to GDPR compliance and the protection of individual privacy rights. They offer regional data hosting in the United States, Europe (EU), and Australia to meet data sovereignty requirements.

certifications.name: PCI-DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Creately uses PCI-DSS Level 1 certified payment processors for credit card processing. This is the payment processor's certification, not Creately's own.

privacy.ai_training_note: AI training stance not explicitly addressed in public documentation. Privacy Policy mentions using data to 'improve our Service' but does not specify whether customer diagrams or content are used for model training. No explicit opt-out mentioned. Contact support for clarification.
